propositions: 40+ Python files in src/rebar exceed 700 LOC; 7 are within 2–4 lines of the 800-LOC hard cap, blocking contributor workflow
Three module-extraction changes (pass1.py → container_stage.py, push.py → push_recovery.py, _submit_ctx to generation.py) reduce file sizes below the cap while preserving all public API re-exports

The CI Module-size gate now emits non-blocking warnings for files in the 10% headroom band (>=720 LOC at cap 800), surfacing a pre-existing metric (module_size_distribution.near_cap_count) that was previously invisible

The `push._git` monkeypatch trap requires late-binding via a `core` parameter in extracted recovery functions to avoid silencing test fakes; the `_submit_ctx` move to generation.py is required because the worker it launches reads generation-owned ContextVars (_CANCEL_SCOPE)
